**Daily Devotional**

**April 12**

*6 But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed. 7 For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord. (James 1:6-7 KJV)*

God’s Word tells us in many places to be consistent, and not to waver in our faith. When we are not consistent in our faith and walk with the Lord, then we cannot expect to reap the benefits of a Christian life. To receive the full benefits of being a Christian, we have to not only be consistent, but also have perseverance in all we do for the Lord. The signs of a mature Christian will be his consistency in all he does and says that one can see the Lord working through him at all times. We are to let our light shine (Matthew 5:16), and the best way to do that is to let the love that God has given us (Galatians 5:22-23), flow out to others, as God is love (1 John 4:8).

When one has true saving faith in Jesus, and has been born again and matured in his walk with the Lord, it should be evident through his life and the fruit that it produces. The way we live our lives is so very important, as our lives are the only witness that some people will ever see or hear about our Lord. Jesus said that if we love Him, we would do as He says (John 14:15). We must obey Jesus to assure our eternal salvation (Hebrews 5:9). Therefore we show our love for Him by the way we live our lives without wavering. Just love your neighbor as yourself (Matthew 22:39), and your light will shine. Thank you Lord for giving us your light, so we can shine.
